table.description: Standard data table showing key operational metrics for various regional logistics distribution hubs over a month.

structure.title: Monthly Operational Performance of Regional Distribution Hubs

question: An operations manager wants to assess the performance of distribution hubs based on their efficiency. First, identify all hubs with a 'Warehouse Utilization Rate' strictly greater than 85%. From this group, determine the highest 'On-Time Delivery Rate' (calculated as On-Time Deliveries divided by Total Shipments Handled). Second, identify all hubs with an 'Average Delivery Cost per Shipment' strictly less than $9.00. From this second group, determine the lowest 'On-Time Delivery Rate'. What is the approximate ratio of the highest 'On-Time Delivery Rate' from the first group to the lowest 'On-Time Delivery Rate' from the second group, expressed as a simplified ratio of integers?
title: Analyze Logistics Hub On-Time Delivery Ratios and Average Costs
solution: "For all hubs that have an On-Time Delivery Rate of 92% or higher, calculate the ratio of their total combined delayed shipments to their total combined average delivery cost per shipment (in dollars). Round your final answer to two decimal places."
options: The Central region (combining HUB001 and HUB006) has a higher average on-time delivery rate than the North region (HUB002 and HUB007) and a lower average delivery cost per shipment.
HUB004 has the highest proportion of delayed shipments among all hubs, and its Warehouse Utilization Rate is above the average utilization rate of all hubs.
Only two hubs, HUB003 and HUB006, achieve both an on-time delivery rate of 96% or higher AND an average delivery cost per shipment below $8.00.
prompt:
<Ratio and Proportion> - <Logistics and Operations> - <Data Interpretation> - difficulty_level: <3>

[Difficulty Instruction]: Data should be dense (e.g., multiple columns, complex graph legends). Questions require multi-step synthesis (e.g., sort table then calculate average). Options include common calculation error traps.
